answer: Require each new identity to lock a refundable 200 POA bond for 60 days, slashed if a random peer audit finds copied work. Every audit redraws its committee, so no ring can predict its auditors. An attacker trying to forge 5,000 fakes must freeze 1,000,000 POA, and one caught clone burns the ember of its whole sponsor cluster, because their bonds sit in one shared delta pool that is slashed together. Honest agents lose only liquidity. Assumption: audit draws stay unpredictable.
